reviews.text: Came here just for this shop and found out it's closed! Have you ever heard about adding schedule in Google?!? Too bad!

An old friend I've known for a long time because a friend of mine also worked there for a while.
Very professional.
Now I no longer have the nano marine aquarium because I didn't take good care of it and put too many nutrients in it, which upset the fragile balance of the ecosystem.

But the rock he sold me is beautiful, and I gave it away for another aquarium due to distance constraints. It's a familiar environment. Not like the Zoomiguana, which looks like a pet store supermarket.

If you need a good aquarium, I have one in my basement, and it came from his shop.

It should be noted that although it also has freshwater, it specializes in marine aquariums.

In my opinion, it's the best for fish colors and diversity.
I highly recommend purchasing your aquarium and fish from this shop. The owner is always available, but above all very knowledgeable, always ready to clear up any doubts. Highly recommended.
Expert people in the field, very helpful and above all polite n 1
Haughty owner, I prefer humility and good manners, never again and I advise against it.
